models.title: Quadcopter flight envelope
models.source:
forward FastFlightComputer {
    rps                 = motor_rpm / 60
    single_thrust_n     = thrust_coeff * air_density * (rps^2) * (prop_diameter_m^4)
    total_thrust_n      = 4 * single_thrust_n
    weight_n            = total_mass_kg * 9.80665
    thrust_weight_ratio = total_thrust_n / weight_n
    climb_accel_mps2    = (total_thrust_n - weight_n) / total_mass_kg
    total_amps_draw     = (total_thrust_n * amps_per_newton) + base_avionics_amps
    voltage_sag_volts   = total_amps_draw * battery_internal_resistance_ohms
    terminal_voltage    = battery_open_circuit_volts - voltage_sag_volts
    delivered_power_w   = terminal_voltage * total_amps_draw
}

models.title: Server capacity (Little's Law)
Portfolio allocation
models.source:
forward FastRebalanceProfile {
    equity_value        = portfolio_value * equity_weight
    bond_value          = portfolio_value * bond_weight
    reit_value          = portfolio_value * reit_weight
    total_weight        = equity_weight + bond_weight + reit_weight
    expected_return_pct = (equity_weight * equity_return_pct) + (bond_weight * bond_return_pct) + (reit_weight * reit_return_pct)
    portfolio_vol_pct   = sqrt((equity_weight * equity_vol_pct)^2 + (bond_weight * bond_vol_pct)^2 + (reit_weight * reit_vol_pct)^2) * diversification_factor
    excess_return_pct   = expected_return_pct - risk_free_rate_pct
    sharpe_ratio        = excess_return_pct / portfolio_vol_pct
}
